presentation.label: AIR CHORUS
presentation.summary: Chris Johnson's Airwindows Chorus, ported to Octatrack FX2 with smooth controls.
presentation.overview: Stereo sine-modulated delay with the original air compensation, three-point read and MIX/depth interaction. This fixed-point development candidate is outside the public catalogue pending complete integration and hardware qualification.
highlights: SPEED, RANGE and MIX with per-sample smoothing
usage: Select Air Chorus in audio-track FX2 SETUP.
Set MIX 0 to return to dry after the smoothing tail.

controls.name: SPD
controls.doc: Fourth-power free-running sine speed, 0–7.019 Hz; 64 is about 0.439 Hz. Per-sample smoothing.

controls.name: RNG
controls.doc: Fourth-power centre delay, 0–92.513 ms. At MIX 127 the modulation sweeps from zero to twice the centre. Two cascaded per-sample smoothing poles.

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: Dry/wet, modulation depth and air compensation together. 0 settles to exact dry, 127 wet only; try 64 for the original plugin default. Two cascaded smoothing poles.

limitations: Draft: not offered in the public library or configurator.
FX2 only; stale FX1 dispatch passes dry without writing its buffer.
About 16-bit delay-buffer precision; dry bypass retains 24 bits.
Extreme modulation retains pitch and aliasing artifacts.
Bus-memory combinations, browser/native composition parity and physical hardware deadlines/persistence are not qualified.

resources.recorded: 8 October 2026: source inventory and conservative static DSP model; chip timing unmeasured.

storage.label: Per-instance used DSP storage
storage.conditions: Uses the existing FX2 allocation. Host reserves 256 X state words per instance; 56 are initialized/used. Shared code/table need another 1,465 P words per core. Not additional sample RAM allocation.

processing.label: Conservative DSP code budget
processing.conditions: Entire reachable word spans, mutually exclusive arms included, with conservative branch/call surcharges and first-call control work charged every 16 frames. Excludes memory stalls and ColdFire stock/platform paths; not measured chip timing.

tests.summary: Native float-reference, control movement, memory, init/bypass and trig-split render checks passed. Eight synthetic instances on two DSP cores match isolated renders. Static sound-quality audit passed. Extreme-modulation audit flags are retained. Native standalone compilation and actual LCD documentation pass; broader composition and hardware qualification remain incomplete.

license.declaration: Chris Johnson's published Chorus source and full MIT copyright/permission notice are retained. The DSP56300 adaptation, tests and thumbnail are original work under MIT. No desktop binary, firmware, extracted stock routine/table or raw memory dump is included.

access.location: Audio-track FX2 SETUP; Air Chorus in the chooser.
steps: Use a disposable audio project and select a Flex or Static track.
Hold FUNC and press FX2, highlight Air Chorus with UP/DOWN, and press YES to assign it.
Press FX2 and edit SPD with A, RNG with B and MIX with F.
Set MIX 0 for dry after the smoothing tail, or select NONE to remove it.

build.reason: Native standalone build and actual custom-effect LCD captures pass. New module still requires hardware, complete browser/native composition and rejection coverage, stock/platform performance evidence and owner first-release review.
